proposedCodeContributions.change: Implement the three normative interfaces in this one module using existing Bun/fs/path/crypto conventions. Read Bun JSONC lock workspaces and fully qualified package keys (including nested versions), resolved versions/integrities, actual artifact inventories and installed LICENSE/NOTICE texts. Output deterministic sorted component/dependency records and SBOM digest bound to external artifact digest, source revision, lock digest, platform/arch and nonsecret build configuration. Include bundled/native/external resources and service/model/codec producer receipts. Separate declared license from concluded reviewed license; unresolved transitive artifacts, origin, notices or flags remain LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED. AuditFileOrigin matches exact destination file hash to repository/source SHA/path, modifications and scoped authenticated reviewer decision; missing/mismatched/overbroad decision denies. ValidateReleaseNotices checks shipped bytes, attribution and exact build variant. CLI consumes the same functions; it is not a new domain server or datastore.

Version the manifest schema and constrain unknown fields. Key component decisions by exact artifact/build variant and component/file digest; record license expression, origin repository/SHA/path, modifications, notice hashes, root/web conflict evidence, reviewer identity, decision/proof and review status. Retain unresolved conflict and unknown transitive rows; never seed fabricated approval. Match Macro root/web records by scope, not root-license precedence. Source provenance inventory is evidence, not an accepted release receipt.

Produce actual reviewed component attribution/license/notice texts from exact packaged inventory while preserving current NOTICE (Craft, Anthropic commercial SDK and Tencent MIT ports/vendor). Review output against exact artifact contents; no blanket package.json pointer in place of required notice text.

Use supported self-hosted runner/Bun conventions from ci.yml. Invoke generator validation against revision-bound artifact/producer receipts and component decisions; fail on unresolved copied origin, conflict, missing notice, altered artifact/SBOM digest, unknown component or unreviewed build flags. Retain digest-bound SBOM, decision and failure evidence. Release publication must depend on this result; a pull-request job alone is not release enforcement.
